span.normalized: Some textbook publishers supply textbooks pursuant to consignment or rental programs which could impact used textbook supplies in the future. Barnes & Noble Education is a national distributor for rental textbooks offered through McGraw-Hill Education's and Pearson Education’s consignment rental program. Barnes & Noble Education does not have long-term arrangements with most of its suppliers to guarantee availability of content or services, particular payment terms or the extension of credit limits.
